_comment: Tool roles of the DV flow (docs/spec/dut-dv.md): compile the UVM testbench with the VIP and the RTL, run one UVM test. Written for Synopsys VCS (UVM from the VCS install; `{extra_args}` carries the VIP's compile options). `q3tui tools init` copies them into the project's config/tools.json, where they are yours to edit. The prepare step's roles: riscv_gcc (the RISC-V GCC), iss (Spike) and sw_build (make on src/sw); `q3tui act riscv_tools_setup` writes them with the paths it finds.

sim_uvm.description: compile the UVM DUT testbench, the VIP and the RTL with VCS (UVM from the VCS install)

run_uvm.description: run one UVM test; the UVM report summary gives UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL counts

riscv_gcc.description: the RISC-V GCC the prepare step builds the test programs with

iss.description: Spike, the reference ISA simulator (expected results); it runs dtc

sw_build.description: build the test programs of src/sw (the Makefile the prepare step writes): GCC images and Spike reference results into PROG_DIR
